summary: Fixed both confirmed SM01 night R3 defects. (1) Render cache: backstage-ui.js signature now includes the four actual marketInfo reason strings (salvage/trade/deliver/power), so player-visible unavailable reasons refresh on false-to-false transitions caused by real movement; board HTML is still rewritten only when the signature changes, never unconditionally per frame. (2) Internal labels removed from player prose: delivery cost small text in backstage-ui.js now says 滚动酒桶（占 3 格）; the safe-night receipt now reads 只对次日白天作数；今夜先记账，领不到钱 without the stage2/feature-not-live wording; the single allowed backstage-core.js marketInfo literal now says 包里需要有滚动酒桶（占 3 格）。 No logic, ids, costs (3 slots), barrel consumption or 4-cups accounting changed. Added 6 regressions in test-market-shift-ui.js: B.step power-reason flip (exact acceptance repro, p675,1085 -> 685.25), B.step delivery far-away -> no-barrel walk, label-free panel/core prose (with and without carried barrel), safe night 1 and 2 receipts (next-day validity, no claim button, zero cups), third-night no-next-day receipt, and bailed/undelivered no-entitlement records. Evidence: before fixes the market pair was 28 pass / 4 fail of 32 (the 4 defect-bearing tests failed); after fixes 32/32. Legacy 60/60 unchanged. Four node --check syntax commands exit 0.
